status_note: Reproduces on 1.6.6. `history()`: fixed on main by [#4797](https://github.com/delta-io/delta-rs/pull/4797) (merged 2026-10-06), not released (latest python-v1.6.6, 2026-09-24). `set_table_properties()`: [#4978](https://github.com/delta-io/delta-rs/issues/4978) open, fix [#5005](https://github.com/delta-io/delta-rs/pull/5005) open, review required.
summary: `DeltaTable.history()` and `DeltaTable.alter.set_table_properties()` keep the GIL during object store requests. A server in the same Python process, such as moto's `ThreadedMotoServer`, never answers, and the call hangs. `optimize.compact`, `vacuum`, `create_checkpoint`, `merge` and `write_deltalake` release it and finish.
repro: Start `moto.server.ThreadedMotoServer(port=5066)`, write a table to `s3://lake/t` with `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5066`, then call `DeltaTable(uri, storage_options=...).history()`: it never returns.
handling: Test against moto in another process (`moto_server`). `DeltaSink` reads the history for its contract, so it hangs the same way in-process. This was the compaction "hang" of the homelab example: its maintenance set table properties first (#377).
